2025-12-08_Chloe-Nguyen_Multimodal-Atten.title: Multimodal Attention-based Deep Learning for Alzheimer’s Disease Diagnosis
2025-12-08_Chloe-Nguyen_Multimodal-Atten.one_sentence_summary: This study develops a novel multimodal deep learning framework (MADDi) leveraging cross-modal attention to integrate imaging, genetic, and clinical data for highly accurate multi-class classification of Alzheimer’s Disease, mild cognitive impairment, and controls.

2025-12-10_Alice-Robertson_A-Quantitativ.title: A Quantitative Approach for Evaluating Disease Focus and Interpretability of Deep Learning Models for Alzheimer’s Disease Classification
2025-12-10_Alice-Robertson_A-Quantitativ.one_sentence_summary: This study develops a quantitative disease-focusing strategy to enhance the interpretability of deep learning models for Alzheimer's Disease classification by evaluating their focus on pathologically relevant brain regions using saliency maps and brain segmentations.

2025-11-10_Chloe-Nguyen_Attention-Is-All.title: Attention Is All You Need
2025-11-10_Chloe-Nguyen_Attention-Is-All.one_sentence_summary: This paper introduces the Transformer, a novel neural network architecture that eschews recurrence and convolutions, relying entirely on attention mechanisms to achieve state-of-the-art results in sequence transduction tasks like machine translation with improved parallelization.

2025-12-02_Bob-Martinez_Data-driven-spat.title: Data-driven spatiotemporal modeling reveals personalized trajectories of cortical atrophy in Alzheimer’s disease
2025-12-02_Bob-Martinez_Data-driven-spat.one_sentence_summary: This paper presents a novel data-driven, personalized graph-based spatiotemporal model that accurately predicts individual trajectories of cortical atrophy and key Alzheimer's disease biomarkers from longitudinal neuroimaging data, supporting precision medicine and therapeutic development.

2025-12-14_Bob-Martinez_Med3D-Transfer-L.title: MED3D: TRANSFER LEARNING FOR 3D MEDICAL IMAGE ANALYSIS
2025-12-14_Bob-Martinez_Med3D-Transfer-L.one_sentence_summary: This paper introduces Med3D, a heterogeneous 3D network co-trained on a newly aggregated multi-domain 3DSeg-8 dataset, demonstrating significant acceleration of training convergence and improved accuracy for various 3D medical image analysis tasks through transfer learning.

2025-11-26_Alice-Robertson_A-Systemic-Pa.title: A Systemic Pathological Network Model and Combinatorial Intervention Strategies for Alzheimer's Disease
2025-11-26_Alice-Robertson_A-Systemic-Pa.one_sentence_summary: This paper synthesizes evolving understandings of Alzheimer's disease as an intricate pathological network and proposes a roadmap for preemptive, biomarker-guided, and personalized combination interventions targeting amyloid-β, tau, and neuroinflammation.

2025-12-24_Daniel-Fischer_LLMs-as-Resear.title: LLMs as Research Tools: A Large Scale Survey of Researchers’ Usage and Perceptions
2025-12-24_Daniel-Fischer_LLMs-as-Resear.one_sentence_summary: This large-scale survey of 816 researchers quantifies how the research community leverages and perceives Large Language Models (LLMs) as research tools, revealing high adoption, potential for research equity, and varying ethical concerns across demographic groups.

2025-11-20_Chloe-Nguyen_Retrieval-Augmen.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
2025-11-20_Chloe-Nguyen_Retrieval-Augmen.one_sentence_summary: This paper introduces Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models, combining pre-trained parametric and non-parametric memory for language generation, which achieve state-of-the-art results on various knowledge-intensive NLP tasks including open-domain question answering.

2025-11-29_Bob-Martinez_A-single-snapsho.title: A single-snapshot inverse solver for two-species graph model of tau pathology spreading in human Alzheimer’s disease
2025-11-29_Bob-Martinez_A-single-snapsho.one_sentence_summary: This paper proposes a single-snapshot inverse solver using a two-species graph model and constrained optimization with sparsity regularization to characterize and calibrate misfolded tau protein spreading in Alzheimer's disease based on clinical neuroimaging data.

2025-11-22_Chloe-Nguyen_Adam-A-Method-fo.title: ADAM: A METHOD FOR STOCHASTIC OPTIMIZATION
2025-11-22_Chloe-Nguyen_Adam-A-Method-fo.one_sentence_summary: Adam is an efficient, first-order, gradient-based stochastic optimization algorithm that adaptively estimates lower-order moments to provide individual learning rates for parameters, performing well in various machine learning problems and having robust convergence properties.

2025-12-04_Alice-Robertson_Pathology-Ste.title: Pathology Steered Stratification Network for Subtype Identification in Alzheimer’s Disease
2025-12-04_Alice-Robertson_Pathology-Ste.one_sentence_summary: This study proposes a novel pathology steered stratification network (PSSN) that integrates systems biology modeling with deep learning to identify fine-grained Alzheimer's disease subtypes based on pathological domain knowledge and longitudinal multimodal neuroimaging data.

2025-11-15_Chloe-Nguyen_An-Image-is-Wort.title: AN IMAGE IS WORTH 16X16 WORDS: TRANSFORMERS FOR IMAGE RECOGNITION AT SCALE
2025-11-15_Chloe-Nguyen_An-Image-is-Wort.one_sentence_summary: This paper demonstrates that a pure Transformer architecture, applied directly to image patches and pre-trained on vast datasets, can achieve state-of-the-art image classification performance, challenging traditional convolutional neural networks.

2025-11-12_Chloe-Nguyen_Deep-Residual-Le.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
2025-11-12_Chloe-Nguyen_Deep-Residual-Le.one_sentence_summary: This paper introduces a deep residual learning framework with identity shortcut connections to ease the training of extremely deep neural networks, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and winning multiple 1st places in ILSVRC and COCO 2015 image recognition competitions.

2025-12-07_Bob-Martinez_A-Quantitatively.title: A Quantitatively Interpretable Model for Alzheimer’s Disease Prediction using Deep Counterfactuals
2025-12-07_Bob-Martinez_A-Quantitatively.one_sentence_summary: This study proposes a novel framework utilizing deep counterfactuals and gray matter density maps from structural MRIs to create a quantitatively interpretable model for Alzheimer's disease prediction, yielding an "AD-relatedness index" for enhanced understanding of disease progression.

2025-12-20_Daniel-Fischer_Freshness-Pers.title: Freshness, Persistence and Success of Scientific Teams
2025-12-20_Daniel-Fischer_Freshness-Pers.one_sentence_summary: This study leverages a network-driven approach on large-scale publication data to show that team freshness and openness to new collaborations, rather than just persistence, are key to producing high-impact scientific research early in a team's lifespan.

2026-01-27_Daniel-Fischer_Weekly-Sync.pd.title: Meeting Summary: Tau-Protein Data Gap and Model Progress
2026-01-27_Daniel-Fischer_Weekly-Sync.pd.one_sentence_summary: This meeting addressed a critical Tau-protein data gap affecting the AD-Fusion-v2 pipeline, necessitating an audit, while concurrently developing architectural adaptations using dynamic masking to manage incomplete multimodal inputs for the generative model.

2026-01-16_Chloe-Nguyen_Hyperparameter-S.title: Optimization and Convergence Analysis: Comprehensive Hyperparameter Sweep Results
2026-01-16_Chloe-Nguyen_Hyperparameter-S.one_sentence_summary: This report details a comprehensive hyperparameter optimization study for a cross-modal deep learning architecture predicting neurodegenerative disease, analyzing the impact of learning rates, batch sizes, and scheduling on convergence, stability, and generalization, highlighting the crucial role of geometric augmentation.

2025-12-16_Chloe-Nguyen_Generative-Adver.title: Generative Adversarial Network in Medical Imaging: A Review
2025-12-16_Chloe-Nguyen_Generative-Adver.one_sentence_summary: This paper provides a comprehensive review of recent advances and promising applications of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) in medical imaging, covering tasks such as image reconstruction, segmentation, and classification, while also addressing challenges.

2026-01-22_Bob-Martinez_Synthetic-Data-G.title: Synthetic Data Generation
2026-01-22_Bob-Martinez_Synthetic-Data-G.one_sentence_summary: This work details a strategy using synthetic data augmentation, combining SMOTE for tabular clinical data and elastic transformations/rotations for MRI, to mitigate class imbalance and improve cross-scanner generalization in Early-Onset neurodegeneration modeling.

2026-01-05_Alice-Robertson_Compliance-Re.title: Urgent Compliance Violation and Directive to Halt All External Data Transfers
2026-01-05_Alice-Robertson_Compliance-Re.one_sentence_summary: The Principal Investigator of the Multimodal AI-AD project issues an urgent directive to halt all external transfers of pseudonymized high-resolution MRI data to a third-party commercial provider due to severe GDPR and contractual violations, emphasizing the re-identification risk and demanding immediate remediation actions.
